title: Smoke: WEBGL renderer
eyebrow: CETI · kit2 infrastructure test · renderer webgl
lede: A 10-second infrastructure film: 120 boxes on a WEBGL canvas, a keyed camera swing, an extruded headline and a neon post pass, under the kit's SVG captions and brand card; the commit beat is off (D11), so it plays straight through.

knobs_doc.name: camSwing
knobs_doc.what: how far the camera swings from the front view to the side (1 = a quarter turn)

knobs_doc.name: boxGap
knobs_doc.what: gap between boxes in world units

knobs_doc.name: neonGain
knobs_doc.what: strength of the neon post glow on the reveal (0 = off)

knobs_doc.name: neonAt
knobs_doc.what: second at which the neon reveal peaks

knobs_doc.name: headTurn
knobs_doc.what: how far the extruded headline turns (1 = a half turn)

captions: The camera swings to the side.

brand.takeaway: The kit draws on WEBGL now.
